'''''Star Wars: Dark Empire II''''' was a series of comic books written by [[Tom Veitch]] and [[Cam Kennedy]], the sequel to ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''. It was originally released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in [[1994]] and [[1995]] as a six-issue monthly series, then in August 1995 as a trade paperback. In 1995, [[Time Warner Audio Publishing]] presented an audio dramatization of the comics known as the [[Dark Empire II (audio drama)|''Dark Empire II'' audio drama]] on cassette. Like the earlier [[National Public Radio|NPR]] [[Star Wars (radio)|radio dramas]], it featured a full cast of actors, parts of [[John Williams]]' classic score and authentic stereo sound effects.
